# PROD-LIFE-02 Versioned offered capability catalog

## 1. What was built

- `src/lib/offered-catalog/schema.ts`: zod schema, domain table (16 domains: vm, container, serverless, triggers, jobs, data, cache, storage, messaging, network, firewall, dns, tls, identity, secrets, day-two), level policy, rollup and invariant checks (explicit entry per provider x portable kind, rollup, content digest, version).
- `src/lib/offered-catalog/derive.ts`: pure derivation from `NATIVE_TYPE_TABLE` plus the real drivers' declarations (compile/observe/runtime/verify/discover flags, executable `operations`, refusal-only `refuses`, per-operation evidence, `experimental`, registration state).
- `src/lib/offered-catalog/offered-catalog.json`: the committed, generated catalog (208 entries = 8 providers x 26 kinds, version `v1-<digest12>`).
- `src/lib/offered-catalog/index.ts`: validated loader, `queryOfferedCatalog`, `parseCatalogFilter`, `offeredCatalogSummary`, `offeredSupport`.
- `scripts/docs/offered-catalog.ts`: generator and drift check (`--check`, `--strict`), reusing `collectMatrix` from `scripts/docs/capability-matrix.ts`.
- API: `src/app/api/platform/v1/capability-catalog/route.ts` (GET, bearer-capable; classified in `_lib/bearer-paths.ts`).
- MCP: `zenith_get_capabilities` now returns `offeredCatalog` (summary) in `src/lib/agent-access/v3/tools/project.ts`. Tool input schema and tool catalog digest are unchanged (no golden change).
- Docs: short note in `docs/platform/MCP.md`.
- Tests: `tests/offered-catalog/{derive,catalog,route,mcp}.test.ts`; `tests/middleware/platform-bearer.test.ts` route inventory count 36 -> 37 and the new path added.

Level rules (all derived, none asserted): `supported` needs a registered, non-experimental driver and `emulated`/`real` evidence; `preview` is implemented and reachable but contract-only, experimental or an ambiguous shared native type; `unsupported` always has a reason (not implemented, refusal-only, simulated, no driver, no native-type row, driver not registered, sandbox simulation). With today's evidence nothing is `supported` (every driver is contract-level), which is the honest result.

## 2. Acceptance mapping

"Explicit matrix covers VM/container/serverless/triggers/jobs/data/cache/storage/messaging/network/firewall/DNS/TLS/identity/secrets/day-two":
- Domains and kind placement (every `PortableKind` in exactly one domain): `schema.ts` `DOMAIN_KINDS`; tests `derive.test.ts` "covers every required domain...", `catalog.test.ts` "is an explicit matrix".
- Triggers: no portable kind models them, so every provider rolls up `unsupported` with that reason (not faked).
- Day-two: per-cell columns for every driver-declared operation plus log groups; rolled up in the `day-two` domain.

"schema/refusal/mock-only paths are not offered services":
- Compiler name without driver is `not_offered`: `derive.test.ts`, `catalog.test.ts` "schema-only, simulated and mock-only...".
- Refusal-only (`aws.rds_instance` database.delete/restore) are unsupported cells: `catalog.test.ts` "refusal-only handlers...".
- Sandbox (simulated) never offered; simulated evidence unsupported; unregistered drivers unsupported: `derive.test.ts`.

Derived from real implementations, drift check: `catalog.test.ts` runs the real CLI `--check` and compares the in-process derivation byte for byte; tamper negative controls in `derive.test.ts`.

Exposure: `route.test.ts` (REST, auth, filters, 400s, bearer), `mcp.test.ts`, `platform-bearer.test.ts`.

## 3. Verification commands (other machine, Node 22)

```
npx vitest run tests/offered-catalog tests/middleware/platform-bearer.test.ts tests/docs/capability-matrix.test.ts tests/agent-v3
npx tsx scripts/docs/offered-catalog.ts --check      # exit 0, "is up to date"
npx tsx scripts/docs/offered-catalog.ts --strict     # same plus exit 1 on any driver inconsistency
npx tsc --noEmit -p .
```
Expected: all pass. If a driver or evidence level changed on the integration branch, `--check` exits 1; run `npx tsx scripts/docs/offered-catalog.ts` and commit the JSON (the version changes). No env vars or services needed (no Postgres/Temporal). `tests/ci/platform-coverage.test.ts` and `src/lib/tofu/engine.ts` have pre-existing tsc errors on the base commit, unrelated to this change.

## 4. Gaps and orchestrator actions

- Gate wiring (do not edit by me): add `npx tsx scripts/docs/offered-catalog.ts --check` next to the existing "Capability matrix is current" step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and add `tests/offered-catalog/*.test.ts` to the unit lane / gate manifest (`scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs`).
- No SQL, no new tables, no migrations.
- The JSON was generated by running the generator once (a pure script, no services); no tests were run.
- Kubernetes and Zenith drivers declare `compile: false` (they apply through their own render/apply path), so `provision` is `unsupported` there with that reason; the catalog does not attest the native apply path per kind. LocalStack has no resource drivers (it runs through the older ProviderAdapter path) so it is entirely `unsupported`.
- Kinds that share a native type with a differently declared driver kind (for example mysql on `aws:rds_instance`, mysql/redis on `k8s:StatefulSet`) are capped at `preview`.
- The catalog is read-only advice; no planner or compiler gate consumes `offeredSupport` yet (out of scope).
- Legacy MCP v1/v2 `get_capabilities` tools are unchanged.
